# Fixture corpus — the regime table

The corpus is a system, not an accident. Every regime the
pipeline claims to handle has a named fixture, measured
properties, and a run of record; `tests/test_fixture_regimes.py`
guards the load-bearing facts in this table.

Why this exists (audit-2026-10-12, Lane 4): dialogue-heavy
fixtures with ~16× less motion energy than Star Tours hid the
motion pathway for weeks — the suite exercised what the fixtures
happened to contain, and nothing measured the fixtures
themselves.

## The regimes

Durations are VIDEO-STREAM durations (`ffprobe -select_streams
v:0`): container format duration is unreliable on these files
(ep4's format header says 271.7 s against a 436.1 s video
stream; Pink Panther's says 546.4 s against 200.1 s).

| Fixture | Source (`input/`) | Regime | Duration | Motion energy (run) | Motion proxy (test) | Onset density (run) | Run of record |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Star Tours | `star_tours_1_ride_film.mp4` | motion-rich | 269.0 s | 0.0227 | 0.0758 | 0.88/s (238) | `output/st_stream_av_full/` |
| Pink Panther / Cato | `sensorium-yt-Tu1RZaFnkKs.mp4` | mixed quiet/action | 200.1 s | — (run had motion OFF) | 0.0665 | 0.85/s (170) | `output/pink-panther-cato-attacks/` |
| FF3 1080p | `ff3_full_hd.mp4` | egomotion | 2701.0 s | 0.0186 | 0.0425 | 1.24/s (3362) | `output/ff3_hd_av/` |
| Dr Tran ep4 | `drtran_ep4_toy_cack.mp4` | dialogue | 436.1 s | 0.0125 | 0.0414 | 1.35/s (588) | `output/drtran_ep4_av/` |
| Quiet room | `quiet_room_60s.mp4` | quiet / near-silent | 60.0 s | 0.000000 | 0.0012 | 0.017/s (1) | `output/quiet_room_60s/` (+ `_adaptive`) |

How each measured column is produced (measured 2026-10-12 for
this table, not transcribed from prose):

- **Motion energy (run):** mean of column 1 of the run of
  record's `motion_energies.npy` — the pipeline's own Motion
  Channel energy over the full run.
- **Motion proxy (test):** mean abs frame difference over the
  first 120 s (full file for the 60 s quiet fixture) at 2 fps,
  320×180 gray — `motion_proxy()` in
  `tests/test_fixture_regimes.py`. A cheap stand-in whose job is
  regime ordering, not parity with the pipeline metric.
- **Onset density (run):** `av_binding.json` `n_audio_onsets` ÷
  `run_report.json` `processed_seconds` from the run of record.

## What the table teaches

- **Frame-diff energy does not separate dialogue from
  egomotion.** Dr Tran ep4 and FF3 sit side by side on both
  motion columns (0.0125/0.0186 run; 0.041/0.043 proxy) while
  their pursuit behavior is opposite: ep4 starved (51 legacy
  pursuits), FF3 egomotion-locked (1,127 legacy pursuits, 100%
  minimum-duration; the disease Phase 3's residual mode treats).
  Regime identity lives in the pursuit/binding outcomes, not in
  raw energy — the table carries both so neither can drift
  unnoticed.
- **Dialogue is onset-dense.** ep4 has the corpus's highest
  onset density (1.35/s — speech) and its lowest motion energy.
  A fixture set chosen by "interesting audio" alone is how the
  motion pathway starved in the first place.
- **Pink Panther's proxy (0.0665) overstates its quiet half:**
  the first 120 s contain the brawl (25–130 s per its beat map).
  Its run of record also predates the motion channel being
  switched on for it — the one corpus row with no run motion
  energy. A motion-on rerun is owed if this fixture's regime
  claims are ever load-bearing.
- **The quiet regime was missing entirely until Phase 4.** No
  corpus fixture exercised the darkness gate, the audio dwell
  rule, or near-zero binding density. The quiet room (below)
  now does, and it immediately produced two findings the noisy
  regimes had hidden (see PREDICTIONS.md Phase 4 scoring):
  a slow global brightening fragments into 8 "visual
  transients" because the median+MAD threshold collapses in a
  near-zero-energy scene, and the batch ear's `dwell-quiet`
  event labels only ~40% of moments because the switch/dwell
  reconsideration is rate-limited (SWITCH_MIN_MS) — the
  remaining moments are unlabeled, not un-dwelled.

## The quiet room fixture (generated)

`input/quiet_room_60s.mp4` is GENERATED by
`scripts/make_fixtures.py` (ffmpeg lavfi, deterministic:
seeded noise, fixed encoder settings) — the one fixture
reproducible from the repo alone. Spec, calibrated to measured
output (constants in the script):

- 60 s, 640×360 @ 30 fps. Near-black base (0x050505, decoded
  luma ≈ 0.012, below DARK_LUM 0.03) with ONE slow faint
  brightening: gaussian, +0.045 luma peak, centered t = 42 s.
- Audio: brown-noise floor, RMS 0.0005 (−66 dBFS) — below the
  streaming ear's 1e-3 RMS gate — with exactly ONE planted
  event: an 880 Hz chime, 0.6 s, 50 ms fades, peak ≈ 0.027
  (−31 dBFS), at t = 30.0 s.
- The chime and the brightening are 12 s apart on purpose:
  nothing in this fixture should AV-bind (measured: 0 bound).

Measured on the Phase 4 runs (fixed clock / adaptive clock):
1 onset at exactly t = 30.0 s; 0 pursuits (residual mode);
motion energy 0.000000; saccades 199 (3.32/s, fixed — the
metronome ignores darkness) vs 94 (1.57/s, adaptive — the
darkness gain stretches the median inter-saccade interval to
700 ms). Batch ear over the same audio: 1 onset-capture at
t = 30.0 s, 0 switches, longest non-capture run 300 moments
(the entire pre-chime half). Full scoring:
`improvements-2026-10/PREDICTIONS.md`, Phase 4.

## Provenance / how each fixture is obtained

All of `input/` is gitignored (`.gitignore`: media stays local;
some of it is copyrighted). The downloaded fixtures exist only
in this workspace — Star Tours is a ride film, Dr Tran ep4 a
show episode, FF3 a game capture, Pink Panther a YouTube clip
(the filename is its video id). Dr Tran eps 1/17 and derived
WAVs also live in `input/` but are batch-era alternates, not in
the streaming regime rotation; ep4 is the dialogue
representative. `input/ff3_seg_1200_1500.mp4` is a 300 s
segment cut of the FF3 fixture for Phase 3 validation runs
(proxy on the segment: 0.0699). The `owl-test*` / `agent-test`
clips are scratch media for recognition/conversation
experiments, not regime fixtures. The quiet room is the only
fixture with a generator: `python3 scripts/make_fixtures.py`.

## Still missing (as of Phase 4)

- A **music-dominant** fixture in the rotation (the YTPMV clip
  in `input/` has no run of record and no measured row).
- **Crossed fixtures:** dark-but-audibly-busy and
  bright-but-silent. The quiet room couples dark + silent, so
  the darkness gate and the dwell rule are exercised together,
  never separately.
- A **stereo/spatial** regime row: `hva/spatial.py` (ILD/ITD)
  has stereo source WAVs in `input/` but no fixture in this
  system speaks to it.
- A **short smoke fixture** (< 10 s, generated) for harness
  checks that don't need 60 s of patience.
